captions.content: In the center of the crater, Ives sways before crashing into the snow.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: IVES!
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Jackie presses her fingers to Ives' neck, checking for a pulse.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: ...Jackie?
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: I'm here! Just hold on. We have to get you back to Kade.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: No can do, kid. My legs... they don't move.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Jackie scrambles through her pockets. Takes out her Serum. It's pink.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Jackie sets the serum in the snow.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: And wraps her arms tightly around Ives.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: I-I can still carry you back.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Jackie gets under Ives' shoulder and begins to lift.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Ah, kid... Just, give me a sec.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Ives, you don't have the time to–
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Alright. Just... please tell me you'll be alright.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Sorry, kid.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: I can't be making any more promises I can't keep.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: I promised you before that we'd find out what happened to your Ma, together.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: But look at me now, not much use to you like this.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: A burning sensation rises in Jackie's chest, threatening to burst from her throat.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Ives, I'm so sorry, it's all my—
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Fight it's shape, not it's strength.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: You taught me that. And it saved my life.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Jackie pulls up her pant leg to reveal the dressing.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: You said you'd be here. Any time. And despite everything, you're here.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Jackie eases Ives down with her arm.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: You've been here, with me, the whole time.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: And yet you never once asked me for anything back.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Kid...
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Jackie tightens her grasp on Ives' shirt.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: ...I found out what happened to Ma.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: ...You did?
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Yeah, I did. I think I see her shadow now.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: ...You've been playing hide and seek with her for quite some time now. Haven't you.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Jackie grasps harder. Tears begin to stream down her face. She nods.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: ...Shit. C'mere, these arms still work.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Ives rests her arms on Jackie's shoulders, and brings her close.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: You know. I expected you to haul me off earlier.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Y-you did?
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Yeah. Glad I was wrong.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Wouldn't be sitting here hearing about your Ma otherwise.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Jackie's breathing steadies. And she pushes herself up to face Ives.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: It's about time we get going. Don't you think?
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Yeah, I suppose so.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Jackie puts her right shoulder under Ives' shoulder, propping her up.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: ...You're the one helping me off the floor now.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Why not, you my babysitter or something?
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Jackie puts her fist out. Ives looks at it briefly.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: ...Hah, no. Never was.
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: And Ives meets it.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Will you... take me with you one more time?
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Yeah. Wherever I am. Wherever I'll go.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: Good... That's good...
captions.speaker: Ives

captions.content: Ives lets out a long breath, before she closes her eyes and leans on Jackie's back.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Feeling Ives' breath go quiet on her back. Jackie rolls to the side and heaves upward.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Standing against the wind and snow, Jackie turns her head toward the arm across her shoulder.
captions.speaker: Narration

captions.content: Any time.
captions.speaker: Jackie

captions.content: And begins the long trek back towards the firelight.
captions.speaker: Narration
